ev.q: This report describes three deaths associated with chelation-therapy--related hypocalcemia that resulted in cardiac arrest.
the patient's serum calcium had decreased to 5.2 mg/dL (normal value for pediatric patients: 8.5--10.5 mg/dL)
The cause of death was recorded as sudden cardiac arrest resulting from hypocalcemia associated with chelation therapy.
